Fast Alpha-Decaying Kernel Computation

Source: R/RcppExports.R
cpp_alpha_kernel.Rd

Computes the alpha-decaying kernel values from distances and bandwidths.

Usage

cpp_alpha_kernel(distances, epsilon, alpha, threshold)

Arguments

distances

Matrix of distances (n x k)

epsilon

Vector of adaptive bandwidths (n)

alpha

Decay parameter

threshold

Threshold for zeroing small values

Value

Kernel values matrix
